label: Notification template
description: An email/in-app notification sent when a record event happens (record.created, record.transitioned, ...) to recipients named by user fields of the entity or the watchers. Subject and body are plain text with {{record.<field>}} placeholders, rendered per recipient with that recipient's permissions.
usage: Notify requesters on transitions they care about (resolved, waiting for them), not on every change.
Start the subject with the record number so threads group well.
Write bodies in plain language and say what the recipient can do next.
constraints: Recipients are user field keys of the entity or the literal "watchers".
Subject and body are plain text; HTML is escaped, never rendered. Placeholders must reference fields of the entity.
Placeholders render with the recipient's field permissions; fields they cannot read render empty.
Internal work notes are never included in notifications to requesters or portal users.

binding.description: Configuration object in a layer's spec catalog; not a layout node.

examples.description: Tell the requester when their ticket changes state

spec.subject: {{record.number}} is now {{record.status}}
spec.body:
Hi,

Your ticket "{{record.title}}" ({{record.number}}) is now {{record.status}}.

Reply to this email to add a comment.
